source_snapshot.criteria: The SOL session establishes successfully and output contains human-readable characters.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL but duplicates the client token, hard-codes cipher 17, exposes the password and uses head without lifecycle proof.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; adds target/channel/ttyS0 identity, protected secrets, bounded observation and recovery.

old_problem: The prior review had a sound two-part oracle and safe lifecycle but left the case on the decision queue for normal external-package, target, owner and expected-output bindings.
disposition_reason: IPMI 2.0 and upstream ipmitool documentation fully define the client/payload lifecycle. The two source criteria are complementary: a client establishment indication bound to the correct payload proves session creation, while recognizable host-specific text proves that the mapped console is actually readable. Installed client, endpoint/channel map, cipher/privilege, session owner, expected tokens, time bounds and recovery are Project Configuration. The upstream client can prompt for a password instead of using source `-P`, and a PTY with documented escape provides deterministic evidence without changing the named tool or coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 837, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2 and historical record were directly reviewed.
Intel IPMI v2.0 defines SOL as an RMCP+ payload and the routing/session boundary; target payload identity is separate from printable console content.
The upstream ipmitool manual defines `lanplus`, password prompting, cipher/privilege and SOL escape controls and warns that command-line passwords are not recommended.
The upstream SOL implementation documents activation, asynchronous data handling and deactivation on clean exit.

ED-20 preserves this exact Source Key/Variant and ipmitool coverage; ED-35 prevents replacing it with ipmiutil; ED-36 makes mapping/owner/text inputs readiness data; ED-38 forbids secret exposure, forced takeover and automatic retry.

test_case.test_name: Establish one bounded ipmitool SOL session and verify target-specific readable console output
test_case.purpose: Prove the pinned ipmitool establishes an authorized IPMI 2.0 SOL payload to the exact intended BMC-mapped host console, receives correct target-specific readable characters and exits without displacing another owner or leaving a stale session.
required_package: Pinned ipmitool version/build and captured help for lanplus, cipher, password, SOL activation and escape behavior
BMC/host/firmware identity, management endpoint and authoritative LAN interface/SOL channel/payload-to-host-console mapping
Dedicated account, minimum approved privilege, target-supported authenticated/encrypted cipher and protected password prompt/file/broker
Pre-session enabled/active/owner state and explicit no-takeover or approved-takeover policy
Approved client establishment token, host-specific banner/prompt/text, encoding/line discipline and observation timeout
Documented escape/close/deactivate rules, transcript redaction, KVM/OOB recovery and pinned internal Script revision if used
test_case.test_command: Record ipmitool version/help, BMC/host identity, SOL channel/payload mapping, supported cipher, current owner/state, expected output and KVM/OOB health; preserve logs. After explicit approval, open exactly one bounded PTY with the reviewed safe equivalent of `ipmitool -I lanplus -C "$IPMI_CIPHER" -U "$BMC_USER" -H "$BMC_IP" -a sol activate`, using password prompt or another approved protected method rather than source `-P`. Capture the client establishment response and timestamped raw/redacted console bytes, match the approved target-specific token(s), send no arbitrary input, then exit using the documented escape. Verify process exit, payload/owner final state and BMC/host/KVM/OOB health. Do not run the inaccessible Script until pinned and reviewed, clear logs, use `head`, force deactivate another owner or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The pinned client authenticates with the approved cipher/privilege to the bound BMC, activates exactly one authorized SOL payload and emits its documented operational response. The same session receives the approved host-specific banner/prompt/text as correctly decoded human-readable characters within the time bound. No other console owner is displaced, no secret is exposed, the escape cleanly ends the client/payload as policy requires, and final management/host health is normal.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Record establishment and readability separately; overall PASS requires both plus clean termination. Establishment requires the supported client response and correct endpoint/channel/owner metadata. Readability requires raw target-specific text under the approved encoding; `SOL Session operational`, printable noise or output from another host is insufficient. Wrong endpoint/channel, auth/cipher error, missing expected token, unreadable/secret-bearing output, owner preemption, timeout, stale payload or management impact is FAIL. Missing package/map/owner/token/time/cleanup/recovery data is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: Verify exact BMC/host/channel/payload and current owner before activation; do not seize or deactivate an unknown active session.
Never use literal `-P`; prompt or use a permission-restricted reviewed secret source and redact authentication metadata.
Use only a target-supported approved cipher/privilege and a trusted management network; do not hard-code cipher 17 without validation.
Bound PTY duration/output, send no arbitrary input/break/power command, and use documented escape rather than piping to `head`.
Preserve baseline logs and console bytes, including corrupt bytes; do not clear or normalize away failure evidence.
No automatic retry. Stop on wrong target, owner conflict, unexpected/sensitive output, timeout or failed cleanup.
expected_evidence: ipmitool build/help, BMC/host identity, SOL interface/channel/payload/console map and pre-session owner/state
Approved cipher/privilege and secret-handling attestation with redacted exact command/session audit
Timestamped client establishment indication tied to the intended endpoint and payload
Bounded raw/redacted transcript containing approved host-specific readable output and encoding assessment
Documented escape, client exit and final payload/owner state with no unauthorized input or automatic retry
BMC/host/KVM/OOB health, preserved log delta and pinned Script review if used
test_case.recovery: On wrong endpoint, owner conflict, auth/cipher error, unexpected or sensitive output, timeout or failed close, stop without retry or console input. Use the documented escape; deactivate only the owned test payload if separately authorized. Preserve the transcript, revoke exposed secrets, verify host/BMC via KVM/OOB and escalate any unowned stale session rather than forcing it closed.
